about.title: About the project
items: Digital library, version 0.0.8
Project created for KGKU "Khabarovsk Center for Social Support of the Population"
Developers: Sokolov Mikhail Andreevich, Razuvaev Sergey Alexandrovich

intro.title: 1. About the system
items: The digital library provides access to the organization's document catalog.
Without signing in you can only browse public materials.

browse.title: 2. Browsing the catalog
items: The home page shows the section tree and a list of documents.
Open a section to see subfolders and files.
Click a document to view it in the built-in viewer.

citizen_categories.title: 3. Citizen categories
items: The Citizen categories item in the menu shows a catalog of categories — a convenient way to find materials by target audience.
Pick a category to see linked catalog folders.
Open a folder to browse documents the same way as in the main catalog.
Only public folders assigned by an administrator appear in a category.

login.title: 4. Signing in
items: Click Sign in in the header to open the login form.
When self-registration is enabled by the administrator, the login page offers a Create account link.
After a successful login, additional sections appear depending on your assigned role.
If registration is disabled and you do not have an account, contact a system administrator.

about.title: About the project
items: Digital library, version 0.0.8
Project created for KGKU "Khabarovsk Center for Social Support of the Population"
Developers: Sokolov Mikhail Andreevich, Razuvaev Sergey Alexandrovich

intro.title: 1. Getting started
items: Sign in using the Sign in button on the landing page or go to /home.
After login you see the main UI: section menu on the left, search bar, notifications, theme toggle, and user menu on top.
The ? icon in the header opens this help page at any time.
Use the sidebar toggle in the header to collapse or expand the navigation menu.

portal.title: 2. Portal and document catalog
items: The Home item in the menu opens the portal catalog with a section tree and material list.
Click a folder to open its contents; click a document to view it in the built-in viewer.
The Feed section contains official portal news. Attachments open like regular documents.
Navigate using the tree on the left or the list in the main area.

library.title: 3. Library
items: The Library menu item combines personal lists: favorites, recent items, and trash.
Favorites — materials you starred for quick access.
Recent — folders and documents you opened recently.
Trash — deleted materials. With sufficient rights you can restore or purge them permanently.

citizen_categories.title: 4. Citizen categories
items: The Citizen categories item in the sidebar opens a catalog with a short description and linked folder count for each category.
Pick a category to see catalog folders assigned to it.
Open a folder — navigation and document viewing work the same as under Home.
Creating and editing categories and linking folders to categories require the appropriate permissions.

documents.title: 5. Viewing documents
items: Documents open in a viewer with page navigation. PDF, images, and other common formats are supported.
For PDFs you can select and copy recognized text when OCR has been run.
Download is available from the viewer toolbar when you have the download permission.
Use the viewer controls to change zoom.
Dual-panel mode lets you browse different folders or documents side by side.

search.title: 6. Search
items: Enter a query in the header search field.
Press Enter or the search button to open the results page.
Results list documents found in the full-text index when search is enabled by the administrator.

tags.title: 7. Tags
items: Tags help group documents by topic.
The Tags menu item shows the tag catalog available in the system.
You can assign tags to documents and folders from the file manager when you have the required permission.
Creating and editing tags in the catalog is limited to administrators and moderators.

profile.title: 8. Profile and notifications
items: The user menu in the top-right corner includes Profile.
In your profile you can change email, first name, last name, and password.
Username and assigned roles are read-only.
The bell icon shows notifications about system events.
Choose Log out in the user menu to end your session.

comments.title: 9. Comments
items: You can leave comments on documents when your role allows it.
You may edit and delete your own comments.
Other users' comments are read-only unless you have moderator rights.

about.title: About the project
items: Digital library, version 0.0.8
Project created for KGKU "Khabarovsk Center for Social Support of the Population"
Developers: Sokolov Mikhail Andreevich, Razuvaev Sergey Alexandrovich

users.title: 1. User management
items: The Users item in the sidebar opens the account list.
Create a user with username, email, and initial password (per your policy).
Assign one or more roles and groups — they define access rights.
Disable an account with the Active flag to block login without deleting data.
Edit other users on their detail page.

roles.title: 2. Roles and permissions
items: The Roles section lists roles and their permission scopes.
Built-in roles: Administrator, Moderator, and Employee.
The Employee role is for browsing, downloading, and commenting without changing catalog content.
Administrator and Moderator roles grant extended rights to manage the catalog, users, and settings.
The role permission tree includes Citizen categories: view, create, update, and delete categories, plus assign folders to categories.
When creating a custom role, grant only the permissions that are truly needed.
After permission changes in code, run paper-cli perms sync on the server.

tags.title: 3. Tag catalog
items: Create, rename, and delete tags centrally in the Tags section.
Users with tag-select permission assign tags from the catalog but cannot create new tags themselves.
Before deleting a tag, check that it is no longer used on important documents.

portal.title: 4. Portal and news feed
items: Edit the portal catalog structure (folders and documents) in the file manager under Home.
Upload files with Upload and create folders with New folder.
The Feed section publishes news with title, body, and attachments from the portal catalog.
Use the Documents… dialog to pick attachments from the portal tree.
On first deploy, initialize the portal catalog with paper-cli portal init on the server.

commander.title: 5. File manager
items: The file manager opens when you enter a catalog or portal folder.
Upload: use Upload and select one or more files from your computer.
New folder: use New folder to create a subfolder.
MSP template: Create MSP template (when you can create folders) adds a root folder with the standard social support measure layout: intake, assignment, and reference materials.
Move: drag selected items onto a target folder.
Rename: select one item and click Rename.
Citizen categories: when one folder is selected, the users-group icon button opens category assignment.
Delete: select items and click Delete — with soft delete enabled they go to trash.
Sorting and quick filter are on the toolbar above the list.
Page operations (extract, rotate, delete pages) are available in the viewer when permitted.

citizen_categories.title: 6. Citizen category catalog
items: The Citizen categories item in the menu opens the category catalog.
Create a category with a name and description — it appears immediately for users and guests.
Edit or delete a category from the row actions. Deleting a category does not delete folders — only the link is removed.
To show a folder in a category, open it in the file manager, select the folder, and assign categories with the users-group icon button.
Only public folders appear in categories for guests.

visibility.title: 7. Document and folder visibility
items: Each document or folder can be public, restricted, or visible only to the owner and moderators.
A visibility icon appears next to the name in the file manager.
Change visibility with the Visibility button when one item is selected and you have node.update.
Public materials are available to guests at /browse without signing in.

audit.title: 8. Audit log
items: The Audit log menu item is available only to superusers.
The log records user actions: views, downloads, catalog changes, and other events.
Use pagination to browse a long history.
The audit log helps investigate incidents and monitor system usage.
